text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions Citation and and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1985 and shall be deemed to commencehave into force on 1st January, 1986. ment.

In this Order-Interpretation. "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority ; "Minister" in Part A of the Schedule means the Minister of Communications and in Part B means the Minister of Finance.

The functions confered or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law functions. specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transfered to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.
